color.note: Cream table, ink type, and three game-piece colours taken straight from the logo. Brand colours at full strength are for shapes, fills and the logo; for text, use the -text variants.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background: the cream game table (light), the ink night table (dark). About 60% of any layout.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, game tiles, menus and inputs sitting on surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, footer, alternating page bands.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers and input borders. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings and the logo's wordmark, on any surface or soft tint. 15:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and metadata on surface, surface-raised or surface-sunken (5.4:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: tomato
tokens.usage: The lead brand colour: the red die. Primary buttons, big shapes, highlights. As a fill, put on-tomato text on it. Never small text on cream (3.3:1).

tokens.name: tomato-text
tokens.usage: Tomato for links and short emphasised text on surface or surface-raised (5.1:1 light, 6.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-tomato
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a tomato fill (4.6:1). Ink, not white: white on tomato fails.

tokens.name: tomato-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted panels and tags behind ink text.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: The second brand colour: the teal die. Illustrations, badges, secondary shapes. Not for text or as a fill behind text; use teal-deep for that.

tokens.name: teal-text
tokens.usage: Teal for text, links and icons on surface or surface-raised (6.2:1 light, 8.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: teal-deep
tokens.usage: Teal fill that carries text: secondary buttons, feature bands. Put on-teal-deep text on it.

tokens.name: on-teal-deep
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a teal-deep fill (6.2:1).

tokens.name: teal-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted panels and tags behind ink text.

tokens.name: mustard
tokens.usage: The accent: highlights, stickers, 'New' badges, a single call-out per view. Use sparingly (about 3% of a layout). Put on-mustard text on it.

tokens.name: on-mustard
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a mustard fill (8.9:1).

tokens.name: mustard-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted panels and tags behind ink text.

tokens.name: pip
tokens.usage: Dice pips and cut-outs on tomato, teal or ink shapes. Stays cream in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmation text and icons on surface ('You're on the list'). Always paired with an icon or words.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Form errors on surface. Sits close to tomato-text in hue, so always pair it with an icon and a message.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px surface gap, then a 2px teal-text ring.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Rubik at heavy weights, set tight: the same voice as the wordmark.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page: the home hero or a game's name.

styles.name: h2
styles.sample: You already know how to play

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Regular for reading; semibold uppercase labels echo the tagline.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Everyone has hit snooze. Now it's a strategy.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Play a card, set your alarm, and hope nobody wakes you first.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows, tags, button text in small buttons, game stats labels.

spacing.note: 4px base; most layouts live on the 8px steps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside tags and small controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related lines, like a title and its stats.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; the minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections on phones.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop.

radius.note: Everything is a die: rounded squares with generous corners. No sharp corners anywhere.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, small cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Game cards, feature panels, image frames: the die corner from the logo.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pips, avatars and pill badges.

shadow.note: A hard 'game piece' drop, like a token sitting on the table. No soft glows.

tokens.name: shadow-piece
tokens.usage: Primary buttons and hoverable game cards. On press, move the element down 4px and drop the shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs, anything floating above the page.
